base_url.description: URL, including the scheme, where the root of the website will be located.

footer.description: Text to add to the footer. Inline Markdown elements will be parsed.

lintian_version.description: Override Lintian's version in output. Leave empty to auto-detect or omit.

manual_file.description: Read Lintian's manual from this FILE.

output_dir.description: Path of the directory where to output the generated website.

tags_file.description: Read Lintian tags from this FILE (in JSON format). Leave empty to use lintian-explain-tags subprocess.
